Because of that, an adversary who spins up 153 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 289 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3401 identities would post 4544 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
